prep-safety.title: Repair safety contract gaps and dependency gates
acceptance: Define contact/clearance by phase, without arbitrary collision exemptions.
A minimal oracle and supervisor must exist before flight/wall-stop; eliminate dependency cycles.
Latch unsafe outcomes; define deadlines, suite membership, and rollout scope.

prep-skills.title: Prepare the trigger-based OMP skill set
acceptance: The router references only existing skills that have been read; do not copy bundles or change accounts/policies.
AGENTS documents the native roadmap and load-on-demand; do not assume an auto-hook or ROS skill is installed.

prep-roadmap.title: Complete the roadmap and operating documentation
acceptance: The DAG covers G0–G4 and the G5 decision gate; only preparation is marked done.
The canonical JSON/view is created by the native tool; documentation links are valid; do not create fake flight receipts.

g0-contracts.title: Offline depth validity, units, and clock contract
acceptance: A real NumPy API distinguishes valid/too-close/no-return/unknown and meter/mm encodings.
Reject unreasonable configurations and invalid/future/stale input according to the clock epoch; tests E01/E04/E08/E20 have independent expected results.
Run fixtures through the API without ROS/GPU, without modifying caller input.

g0-geometry.title: Projection, frame transforms, and conservative coverage
acceptance: Optical/FLU/ENU/NED projections and quaternions have analytic expected results, with correct intrinsics/cropping.
The 72x3 histogram preserves near evidence, unknown regions, and wraparound; footprint inflation does not create false gaps.
A04/A05/B07/C08/E02/E03/E05/E06/E07/E13 are demonstrated offline at the geometry level.

g0-safety.title: Offline braking envelope and command freshness
acceptance: The braking-bound API checks distance/margin/latency/actual velocity and invalid configurations.
A heartbeat must not refresh a stale proposal; an unknown corridor does not authorize movement.
Boundary fixtures include d<=margin, a<=0, NaN, stale epochs, and velocity deviating from the intended direction; do not call this SITL calibration.

g0-demo.title: Gate G0: reproducible offline smoke run
acceptance: A real command runs synthetic depth through the core to a histogram/safe proposal and exports a viewable artifact.
Behavioral tests and the smoke run pass on an identified snapshot; no fake ROS node/runner.

g1-environment.title: Select and lock the Linux PX4/ROS/Gazebo environment
acceptance: The user authorizes every required installation/download; explicitly block if a prerequisite is missing.
Pin the image/packages/firmware/messages/Agent/assets after the smoke run; do not infer them from the image name.
Actually observe X500 depth, camera encoding/CameraInfo, odometry, and clock/QoS/namespace, without arming yet.

g1-oracle.title: Contact/clearance oracle and logger before flight
acceptance: Known-free/known-contact fixtures demonstrate that the observer is live and that the geometry/propeller envelope and landing-contact allowlist are correct.
Record phase-aware clearance, a contact ledger, and raw logs; the planner must not read the oracle.
Missing oracle data must not become zero collisions; infrastructure outcomes must not overwrite the unsafe latch.

g1-supervisor.title: Minimal supervisor and single-owner Offboard bridge
acceptance: The supervisor/bridge is independent of the planner/inference, with explicit command TTL/epoch/progress.
Priming/acknowledgment/mode/arming ownership, unused PX4 fields, and handoff have contracts appropriate to the firmware.
Stationary fault injection demonstrates that stale commands/owner conflicts do not authorize movement; do not treat this as a flight braking test.

g1-flight.title: Empty-world mission: takeoff, square, hold, land, disarm
acceptance: In a known-clear test volume, fly a square with 5 m sides, hold at the goal, and land/disarm with real bag/ULog/acknowledgment evidence.
Use a bounded exploratory speed, an operator stop, and a supervisor; do not disable preflight checks.
Phase-aware floor/landing contact must not cause false failures; contact with any other obstacle always fails.

g1-calibration.title: Gate G1: measure the stopping envelope and fault handoff
acceptance: Measure delay/braking/jerk/tracking using actual motion and load levels; freeze bounds/deadlines together with the safety configuration.
Test C02–C04/E09–E12/E21–E23 on the components actually available; no reclaim when the bridge dies and PX4 exits Offboard.
Handle camera/pose loss according to a tested mode; do not promise unconditionally safe hovering/landing.

g2-adapter.title: Depth adapter and capture-time obstacle evidence
acceptance: Verify sensor semantics/TF/calibration; preserve the capture-time pose and epoch.
Do not filter out near evidence; explicitly document finite-sampling/FOV/height-envelope limitations.

g2-replay.title: Bag replay and controlled sensor faults
acceptance: Replay real bags in a new epoch; sensor dropout/blur/flicker has injection traces and an oracle.
For A01–A10/E01–E08/E13/E14/E24/E25, distinguish pure fixtures from sensor-specific SITL.

g2-wall.title: Gate G2: 10/10 wall-stop runs through a real supervisor
acceptance: 10/10 wall approaches from outside the stopping envelope, with no contact/clearance violation according to the oracle.
Log actual velocity, wall/sim latency, and data age; Collision Prevention debugging must not count as Offboard protection.

g3-planner.title: Local planner with hysteresis and goal hold
acceptance: A real planner produces velocity/yaw proposals with expiration times, without reading ground truth.
Test corridors/poles/goal yaw-wrap/oscillation; unknown regions in other directions must not be treated as free.

g3-recovery.title: Bounded recovery and mission transitions
acceptance: B01–B05 and A08/E16/E17 have controlled runs; do not reverse blindly or turn when the envelope is unsafe.
Fix retries/state transitions/deadlines before testing; safe abort for an unreachable goal is a separate outcome.

g3-runner.title: Single-world executor and fault injection harness
acceptance: Run/attempt ownership and start/preflight/execute/collect/cleanup work on real SITL scenarios.
Correctly classify known failure/contact/infrastructure traces and retain every artifact; exit codes 0/1/2 follow the contract.

g3-faults.title: Safety/observer fault regression suite
acceptance: A–D/E/F cases within G3 scope have an oracle and evidence index; leave ML cases for G4.
Impossible-spawn/dynamic stress tests check classification; do not mix them into the zero-collision navigation benchmark.
Shutdown/telemetry loss must not hide an already observed unsafe event.

g3-worlds.title: World validator and frozen seed split
acceptance: Oracle routes preserve the footprint/margin, fixed-altitude connectivity, and segment/corner collision checks; not just grid-center A*.
Freeze dev/test seeds together with noise/assets/configuration before testing; the rejection ledger must not exclude cases based on planner outcomes.
The oracle route is an efficiency reference; do not call it dynamically optimal without proof.

g3-batch.title: Batch evaluator and protection against denominator manipulation
acceptance: Run all first attempts for 50 valid test worlds; report retries/infrastructure failures/missing runs/duplicates separately.
Actually export Wilson CI, outcome counts, clearance window, route time ratio, latency/deadline/RTF, and artifact links.
Unsafe/infrastructure outcomes must not be marked as success or overwritten; an incomplete batch must not exit 0.

g3-acceptance.title: Gate G3: simulation-depth navigation acceptance
acceptance: At least 45/50 SUCCESS on the frozen navigation suite, zero unsafe events, and navigation surface clearance>=0.5 m.
Time-to-goal/latency gates have a protocol and calibration; required safety cases pass according to suite semantics.
The report/demo/raw evidence and revisions are reproducible; do not claim a general probability>=90% or real-flight safety.

g4-stereo.title: Stereo SGBM and offline metric gate
acceptance: Stereo pairs are synchronized/rectified, baseline/intrinsics/units are valid, and uncertainty/dropout is preserved.
Compare against simulation truth offline for near-field overestimation and latency; do not use truth for online adjustments.
Fly only when the new source meets the safety bounds; rerun applicable scenarios.

g4-mono.title: Monocular metric adapter and OOD safety gate
acceptance: Pin the exact checkpoint/license/preprocessing/weights revision; demonstrate metric scale/focal length after resizing/cropping.
E18/E19/F06 pass offline before control; relative depth must not be compared against meter thresholds.
Do not train/fine-tune or download weights without authorization; block if hardware/latency prerequisites are missing, with no fake fallback.

g4-acceptance.title: Gate G4: compare depth sources on the same worlds
acceptance: Each reported source achieves at least 40/50 on the frozen 50 worlds, maintaining zero unsafe events and the clearance gate.
Report accuracy/uncertainty/latency/RTF/source-specific failures and separate evidence; simulation-depth results must not be reused to certify a model.

sim-delivery.title: Hand over the simulation project and reproduction instructions
acceptance: README/setup/run/evaluate commands match the product, with complete dependency pins and artifact provenance.
Provide a real demo, limitations, and license/dependency notes; do not distribute weights/assets in violation of their licenses.
Code/tests/docs share the same revision, with no placeholders/no-ops, and must not be described as real flight.

g5-decision.title: Optional G5 decision: mapping, VIO, planner, or hardware
acceptance: The user selects a direction and confirms the new scope/criteria; do not autonomously purchase or deploy hardware.
Add implementation tasks with real dependencies/evidence after the decision; do not treat the choice task as completed G5 integration.

prep-sensor-replay.title: Unarmed sensor recording and offline geometry replay
acceptance: Capture a bounded real Gazebo bag with depth, CameraInfo, clock, static TF, PX4 odometry and vehicle status in the pinned environment; remain Disarmed with no control publishers or arming commands.

Replay paired observations with validated capture-time timestamp_sample poses, full capture orientation, explicit frame conventions and reset/epoch handling; reject missing, stale, future, unsupported or unbracketed inputs.

Compare reconstructed geometry with independent declared targets using regions, alignment and effective numeric criteria fixed before grading; report per-target support and errors without using oracle geometry as navigation free-space evidence.

Exercise dropout/gap/reset replay variants and preserve the spike's near-hazard, empty-grid and sensor-range guards; report a stationary blind-zone STOP honestly and do not count synthetic liveness as real-data navigation.

Deliver reproducible bags/manifests, replay figures and exercised checks in English; this preparation branch does not complete G1 flight/calibration, G2 adapter/replay acceptance or wall-stop, and does not relax their dependencies.

prep-replay-integrity.title: Bind replay alignment epochs and recording evidence integrity
acceptance: Freeze world-to-odometry alignment from capture-time bracketed poses and bind it to the recorded reset/clock epoch; reset, mismatch or excessive alignment gap invalidates world grading instead of silently reusing a transform.

Require fresh depth, CameraInfo, odometry, clock and Disarmed status throughout bounded unarmed recording; preserve explicit incomplete reasons for stream loss and record subscriber/publisher QoS and monotonic receive progress.

Report available simulation/wall duration, RTF, image gaps, pairing versus availability and estimator uncertainty honestly; old bags missing wall/epoch provenance remain explicitly historical rather than acquiring fabricated metadata.

CI verifies every published evidence checksum and applicable archive/fixture identities on Windows and Linux; exercise actual pinned-schema bag decoding and reset/dropout failures without arm, control publishers, installation or altered historical evidence.

prep-model-profile.title: Derive pinned physical geometry and rerun corrected-mount liveness
acceptance: Derive base-link-relative asymmetric collision bounds and rotating propeller sweep from the pinned model, preserve source identities and distinguish physical geometry from phase clearance and localization/tracking/angular budgets.

Use the SDF-derived optical mount for new experiments while preserving explicitly labeled historical fixtures; rerun liveness with mount and effective envelope together rather than reusing the old one-metre admission claim.

Exercise known points on gear, body and propeller sweep and report unsupported mesh/attitude assumptions; these preparation results are reusable inputs, not completion of the g1-oracle contact ledger or flight calibration.

prep-ttl-replay.title: Observe rolling evidence expiry in a longer unarmed recording
acceptance: Capture a bounded stationary Disarmed sequence longer than the declared simulation-time evidence TTL under the integrity recorder; retain raw messages and wall/sim diagnostics with explicit limits and failure reasons.

Query during the real trace to demonstrate old frames expiring while fresh frames remain, then stale-all STOP; keep raw recordings immutable and distinguish temporal replay queries from sensor captures.
Do not teleport the vehicle, certify no-return semantics, claim positive real-data movement or waive G1/G2 dependencies; kinematic liveness remains a separately scoped decision.

prep-evidence-semantics.title: Repair evidence semantics and measure truth-relative TTL error
acceptance: Finite near-depth hazards retain complete capture-pose pixel cones clipped at optical Z 0.3 m; negative infinity remains global fail-closed. Corrected rest fixtures derive from the complete physical profile without erasing retained hazards.

Pinned-decoder continuous truth measures absolute and all-pairs capture/query relative pose errors within TTL, with full quaternion angle, true ray range, body lever arm, clock-bracket coverage and uncalibrated non-admitting labels.

Independent retained-frame identity checks exercise a mid-trace camera gap longer than TTL, recovery and an early-only obstacle expiry variant. Actual replay compares historical and model-derived diagnostic envelopes without changing original ROI or grading thresholds.

Retain frozen sweep failures, baseline recordings, effective inputs and source hashes. An explicit supplemental project checker prevents completed G2 tasks while this preparation task is not done; no native dependency edge is claimed and no G1 task is blocked.

prep-evidence-review.title: Repair uncertainty provenance and independent y-plane evidence
acceptance: Require explicit near-evidence uncertainty and provenance across synthetic, historical and diagnostic consumers; no implicit operational zero or fabricated calibration.
Pass offline nonoccluding fixture preflight on the declared pose grid with unchanged primary ROIs, 3-pixel erosion and support/error limits; retain the old fixture as a failing negative.

After separate acquisition approval, retain fresh pinned unarmed recording with passing original primary geometry and independent dy residual/truth comparison under frozen justified budgets. Historical failed evidence stays unchanged.
Supplemental G2 completion gate only; does not block unrelated G1 work or replace calibration.

prep-flight-oracle.title: Add moving-interval, isolation and phase-aware oracle evidence
acceptance: Conservative interval coverage uses explicit justified translation/angular bounds and complete geometry; missing coverage is UNKNOWN and unsafe observations remain latched.
Evaluator-owned phase transitions require independent status/support and frozen schedule; planner intent cannot grant contact exemptions.
Bounded retained endpoint discovery detects unexpected and disappearing readers without claiming DDS security; acceptance truth follows an evaluator-only path before planner participation.
Exercise offline boundary/negative cases and separately approved unarmed fault proofs before g1-flight preflight; static historical receipts remain static.

prep-depth-path-audit.title: Locate depth-path losses with matched stage identities
acceptance: Match actual source, bridge, callback, enqueue and storage identities within common fully observed windows; account for duplicates, reordering, probe loss and bounded drain.
Unknown or unavailable stage instrumentation remains unresolved; secondary BEST_EFFORT subscriptions do not certify publication counts.
Distinguish controlled source skip, transport loss and recorder/storage backpressure; report simulation gaps separately from receive-wall gaps, never as end-to-end latency bounds.
Retain separately approved unarmed acquisition and frozen workload/QoS provenance as a supplemental g1-calibration completion input; no deadline relaxation.

prep-geometry-crosscheck.title: Crosscheck resolved mesh loading and conservative rotor geometry
acceptance: Compare unchanged pinned asymmetric mesh transforms with independent Gazebo geometry or calibrated multi-view observations, retaining wrong-axis/scale negatives and explicit visible-surface limits.
Quantify analytic rotor containment and liveness without shrinking current outer bounds or 0.5 m navigation clearance; any new primitive requires complete consumer migration and containment proof.
Record source/view/tolerance provenance and separate offline analysis from separately approved renderer execution; a containment contradiction blocks affected geometry.
